input.summary: Broaden Type II Materials licence to perpetual, royalty-free use/modify/sublicense for Customer's business and limit IBM's use of Customer data to providing the Services.
input.comment: [Playbook] We accept IBM's ownership of Type II Materials, but our licence must be perpetual and royalty-free and let us modify and sublicense the deliverables for our business rather than only use them inside our Enterprise. We also limit IBM's licence in our data to processing it solely to provide the Services, in place of the marketing and Business Partner uses.

ops.oldText: IBM grants Customer an irrevocable, nonexclusive, worldwide, paid-up license to use, execute, reproduce, display, perform, and distribute, within Customer's Enterprise only, copies of Type II Materials.
ops.newText: IBM grants Customer a perpetual, irrevocable, nonexclusive, worldwide, paid-up, royalty-free license to use, execute, reproduce, display, perform, modify, distribute and sublicense copies of Type II Materials for Customer's business.

ops.oldText: Such information will be processed and used in connection with our business relationship, and may be provided to contractors, Business Partners, and assignees of IBM Corp. and entities within its Enterprise for uses consistent with their collective business activities, including communicating with you (for example, for processing orders, for promotions, and for marketing research).
ops.newText: Such information, and all other data belonging to, supplied by, or processed for Customer, will be processed solely to provide the Services.
